heading: INT. REVOLVING RESTAURANT ATOP A TELEVISION TOWER - NIGHT

units.text: INT. REVOLVING RESTAURANT ATOP A TELEVISION TOWER - NIGHT
White tablecloths.
A slow circular carpet.
The city lights sweep past the glass like a clock hand.
At a corner table sit two couples and a waiter.
DIMITRI OKAFOR-LIND (50s, sharp tie) stirs his coffee without drinking it.
His wife SOLANGE ASHWORTH-NDIAYE (40s, pearls, sharp eyes) watches the room.
Across from them, HALVARD PEREIRA-GOH (40s, tuxedo, a bandaged wrist) smiles too widely, while his date SABINE KOWALSKI-ABARA (30s, red dress, tense jaw) spins the stem of her glass.
The WAITER, THEODORE BRIGHT-OSEI (20s, ironed apron), refills the water.
The restaurant turns one degree.
Dimitri glances at Halvard.
Halvard glances at Sabine.
Sabine glances at the waiter.
The waiter, hands steady, sets the pitcher down, slides a folded napkin to Solange and steps back with a bow.
Solange unfolds it beneath the table and reads.
Her face does not move.
Well?
units.name: DIMITRI

units.text: Sit still.
units.name: SOLANGE

units.text: The restaurant turns another degree.
Halvard lifts his glass to his lips, and Sabine, without looking, takes his wrist.
He freezes.
Dimitri's hand slides toward his jacket.
Theodore, still beside the table, tightens his grip on the pitcher handle.
Solange folds the napkin back along its creases, lays it by her plate, and smiles at Sabine for the first time.
She tells me the elevator has stopped.
units.name: SOLANGE

units.text: The lights go out.
In the dark, the carpet keeps turning, and she says nothing at all.
